items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Melvin Elastic. No, Melvin Elastic playing the third, I decided. I mean Monday, the 30. I forgot his name, he's a guitar player, manager of the band.

ctx.x: I didn't call them what you're playing that Monday night, I'll tell you the name of them.

They're playing the blues singers there, I mean, playing the blues singers. Where is that? Up on Louisiana Avenue. Boy, in this place. They got one on the 30, too, they got one. Melvin Elastic. No, Melvin Elastic playing the third, I decided. I mean Monday, the 30. I forgot his name, he's a guitar player, manager of the band. Bass player, played one of them, electric bass. Yeah. He's the manager of the band. Fender.
